objective: Accretion laws over abstract names: a board grows from a seed, each step decided by the radius-r view of a site, values from a finite alphabet, every fair order counted. To be proved: (G1) a law none of whose actions closes a cycle grows only trees, so no such law grows the plane in any order; (G2) a law that names the square and carries a marker grows exactly the plane in its only order (a spiral); (G3) the square-closing law of every radius, without a marker, has a fair order whose limit is not the plane (a slit filled from both sides leaves two sheets). Checks: the spiral to many turns, the slit order and a control order for several radii.
status: Proved 2026-11-10, revised after an independent review before publication: (G1) a law closing no cycle grows, in each component, the seed's component with trees attached (asymptotic dimension at most 1; the comb grows quadratically), which follows from the frozen definition of naming a face; (G2) a radius-2 square-closing law with coordinates mod 3 and an arrow grows the square spiral in its only order; (G2') with coordinates mod 3 alone, a site enabled when its radius-2 view is one of the spiral head's 77 views grows the same spiral (Lemma S: views repeat every three rings; checked to 40 rings, no clash); (G3) for every radius r >= 2 and every fixed priority the square-closing law has a fair order whose limit is not the square grid. Checks P1 to P5 passed (P4, P5 added after the review). Referee: two passes, sound after fixes.
title: Accretion needs a named face
